'''JO9-4MN''' was a boxy,<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> primitive model of [[power droid]]<ref name="LostFoundAD" /> manufactured by [[Veril Line Systems]] that was repurposed by the [[Trade Federation]] to act as a [[Maintenance droid|repair droid]] and foreman on the [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class Yield Conveyer]] ''[[Fallon]]''. It was responsible for work assignments and monitoring billable work [[Standard hour|hours]] and kept an active telemetric diagnostic link to each of the [[Environment suit|spacesuits]] used by the [[starship]]'s [[meknek]]s.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> it passed by the mekneks [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Fillik]] outside Aniseya's [[Bunk 23|bunk]] in one of the corridors on the ''Fallon'' as they headed to the ship's exterior to make [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]] repairs.<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> JO9-4MN had [[Color|gray]] plating with yellow lining and a blue [[photoreceptor]], with a primary [[sensor]] cluster on its side. The droid's two [[Limb|feet]] were [[gravity]]-adjusted.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
JO9-4MN appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> It was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
